cpu_repeat_rule: Only after concrete CPU failure repair; no unchanged suite repetition
source_failure: Actual nested driver callbacks share correlation ID 119 within runtime parent; analyzer incorrectly keys individual callback invocations by domain/correlation alone
allowed_change: Pair callback invocations by recorded unique enter_seq/PID/TID/domain/cbid with nesting; join activities only with unambiguous supported identities. Preserve reject for ambiguous ownership/missing data.
conditional_nsys: Only corrected offline analysis of unchanged prior CUPTI raw is valid and representative. Reuse exact probe binary; separate Nsight process, same pinned tool/options; no new CUPTI sample, shape or algorithm sweep.
stop_conditions: CPU bound reached or offline analysis invalid/not reproduced: no Nsight
ENV or monitoring or cleanup failure: ENV_ABORT own processes only
evidence_scope: Local mechanism only; old6381/model completeness/normal performance not accepted
